# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Branch uses the antonio-in-stem/ prefix.
- [ ] Commits use the repository owner's configured identity.
- [ ] Public-facing new text uses m-project where an umbrella name is needed.
- [ ] No dependency folders, local databases, logs, build outputs, private binaries, or .local-references/ files were committed.
- [ ] Main changes are going through a pull request rather than a direct push.
